title: VendPoint Retired Item Credits: Delay Since the Latest Vend
content:
On the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program, the longer a retired item's failed latest vend has stood uncredited, the larger the delay share added to the vend error credit Corbett owes for it.

**Rule.** The delay share follows the calendar days from the date of the latest vend to today: at least the long delay days give the long-delay share, one or more but fewer give the short-delay share, and none gives no share.

**Figures.** The long delay days are 7; the long-delay share is 0.1; the short-delay share is 0.05.

The latest vend is the retired item's vend carrying the highest vend transaction number, and its date is that vend's date.

| Calendar days from the latest vend to today | Delay share |
|---|---|
| 0 (the vend is dated today) | None |
| 1 to 6 | 0.05 |
| 7 or more | 0.1 |

Hypothetical dates: a latest vend dated 3 May gives 6 days on 9 May (0.05) and 7 days on 10 May (0.1).
